title: They are thin and kind of Translucent
text: They are thin and kind of Translucent. They are cute curtains but I would only recommend them for decoration. I bought these for my son's room and bummed how translucent they are and need to find an alternate solution for his room.

product_metadata.title: Sonic The Hedgehog Kids Room Window Curtain Panels Drapes Set, 82 In x 63 In, (Official) Sega Product By Franco, Prints May Vary
features: SONIC THE HEDGEHOG DESIGN (PRINTS MAY VARY): Bring the fast-paced excitement of Sonic The Hedgehog into your child’s world with these bold and colorful drapes. Featuring Sonic, Knuckles and Tails from the iconic Sega franchise, these drapes add sunny skies to any room regardless of the weather outside.

FUN ROOM DECORATION: A cute and colorful way to brighten up a child’s bedroom, nursery or playroom, these kids’ curtains feature a "SEGA Sonic Rings in the Sky" theme your little gamers will love. These vibrant drapes instantly add privacy and a playful look to the room of any Sonic fan.

SOFT AND DURABLE: Made of soft microfiber, these window curtains offer a fun playful look and soft feel they'll love. These panels won't completely block the sunlight but filter it nicely for privacy making it a perfect home, school or preschool classroom, nursery decor accessory for children and toddlers.

EASY CARE: You can throw the window curtains into the washer and dryer without worrying about the colorful animated themed cartoon characters fading or the need for ironing. The material is wrinkle-resistant making it a great choice for any child's room.

ITEM INCLUDES: 2 decorative window curtain panels. Each panel measures 41" (W) x 63" (L). The pair of 2 panels together measures 82" (W) x 63" (L) and is designed to fit a 36" - 48" wide window. The panels have a 2" rod pocket designed to fit a standard curtain or decorative rod.
description: Featuring Sonic The Hedgehog, Knuckles and Tails from the popular Sonic franchise, these colorful drapes are sure to be a game winner with young Sega fans. Create a fun focal point in a child’s bedroom, nursery or playroom with help from the colorful "SEGA Sonic Rings in the Sky" imagery on these high-quality drapes. These microfiber window curtains have the playful look and soft feel that kids love. The fun design features Sonic, Knuckles and Tails racing for rings against the blue skies of Mobius. Use these drapes to create a cohesive look in a Sonic-themed room while also adding some privacy from the outside world. The drapery panels don’t block out sunlight completely, but rather filter it gently for a soft and comfortable look. Fast-paced action, engaging graphics, and colorful characters continue to attract new generations of Sega fans to the world of Sonic The Hedgehog. Now fans can join in on the fun at home with colorful drapes that reflect the bold, speedy style of the iconic Sega characters.
